Overview

Steyr is a city in Upper Austria with a population of 38,056. A historic industrial town at the confluence of the Enns and Steyr rivers, known for its well-preserved medieval old town and the Steyr Arms manufacturing heritage. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5b growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
